_comment: No composite indexes required. Every list query in the API filters by equality only
(user_id, and optionally motorcycle_id / doc_type / is_active) and sorts in memory,
which Firestore serves from its automatic single-field indexes.
This is deliberate: a rider holds tens to hundreds of documents, so sorting server-side
costs nothing, and the app can never break because indexes were not deployed.
'My rides' uses member_ids array-contains on rideGroups rather than a collection-group
query on members, for the same reason.
If a future feature needs a real composite index, add it here and run
`npm run deploy:indexes` (service account) or `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`.
